summary: fractal-ui transcripts mount the newest page first, backfill older turns while idle, skip off-screen turns with content-visibility, and keep each turn's identity when history is prepended

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes; no protocol, harness or CLI change. TranscriptSkeleton is a new export without Markdown or runtime imports. Hosts pass the same props.
